thread:
maria (Design): quick microcopy check — the toast after a user stops a dedicated pool currently says: `Stop initiated` with a single action button `Revert`. Feels vague about what actually happened. screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/stop-toast.png :thinking:

alex (Product): i saw that. my first read was "i already stopped it" but not sure if jobs were canceled or if it's queued to stop. we should surface consequence.

vikram (Eng): agree. runtime actually drains and cancels queued jobs immediately. toast should avoid ambiguous verbs. also we have an undo window of 30s.

maria (Design): proposed variants (short list):
```
1) "Stopping pool — jobs will stop.
   [Undo]"
2) "Stop scheduled — pool is draining.
   [Cancel stop]"
3) "Pool stopped — running jobs canceled.
   [Undo stop]"
```
Which do people prefer? trying to balance accuracy and brevity. aria note: toast should include `role=alert` and an accessible label describing the cancellation impact.

olivia (QA): prefer option 1 or 2. Option 3 reads like it's already done which can confuse users who expect undo to work. Test suggestion: simulate network slowness and see if message matches state.

alex (Product): +1 to option 2 but tweak to remove passive voice: "Stop scheduled — pool is draining (running jobs will be canceled). [Cancel stop]". That pairs well with CTA `Cancel stop` which maps to the undo action.

vikram (Eng): wording nit: "draining" might be jargon for non-technical PMs. maybe "shutting down" or "preparing to stop". also we need consistent verb tense across other toasts (see: `Deploy started`, `Rollback applied`).

maria (Design): new iteration combining ideas: `Stop scheduled — preparing to stop the pool. Running jobs will be canceled. [Cancel stop]` (CTA primary on the right). Thoughts?

alex (Product): looks good. can we shorten to a single line for the toast but expand in an accessible label? e.g., toast shows: `Stop scheduled — running jobs will be canceled.` and screen-reader label includes the extra context and undo hint.

olivia (QA): test cases to add to PR: 1) ensure `Cancel stop` API call is idempotent, 2) verify undo window timing shows countdown in aria-live, 3) keyboard focus lands on toast action when toast appears if user triggered stop via keyboard.

sam-bot: deploy-bot: branch "stop-toast-copy" created -> PR #842.

maria (Design): awesome — i'll push final copy into PR and add a11y notes. thanks all :thumbsup:
